title: Exploring the Concept of Exclusive Worship  A Thought Provoking Perspective #athiest #worship

top_liked.text: Appreciation, gratitude, expectation, respect, accountability, obligation etc all become a tainted thing when one side is on a pedestal (worshipped). It corrupts everything involved, including that which is held higher.
